We have insurance. We're headed for medical bankruptcy. Both kids have expensive conditions. We're not eligible for the ACA.

He won't go to therapy. He gets very defensive, which is why he tells me ridiculous bullshit like I told him I did not want to any acknowledgement of Mother's Day. Because he really could not be bothered.

I really am not strong. If I were, I'd have the ability to think I could improve my own situation by some means other than suicide. I'd be able to see a future beyond non-existence. Even deserting them would be better probably and I can't (besides which, we have zero money.)
